title: Singly linked list
statement: Start simple: Build a singly linked list with addFirst, addLast, removeFirst, and values. values returns the comma-separated contents from head to tail, or an empty string. The theory is optional. The C solution appears after the hidden tests pass.
constraints: removeFirst on an empty list returns null.
think: A node holds a value and the next node.
The list is correct only while head points at the first node.
addFirst changes head; the old head becomes next.
addLast walks until next is null, except when the list is empty.
hints: Draw the links before writing the assignment.
Save the old head before replacing it.
An empty list is the special case for both ends.

tests.name: first
tests.call: { LinkedList list = new LinkedList(); list.addFirst(2); list.addFirst(1); return list.values(); }

tests.name: last
tests.call: { LinkedList list = new LinkedList(); list.addLast(1); list.addLast(2); return list.values(); }

tests.name: remove
tests.call: { LinkedList list = new LinkedList(); list.addLast(1); list.addLast(2); return list.removeFirst() + ":" + list.values(); }

tests.name: mixed
tests.call: { LinkedList list = new LinkedList(); list.addFirst(2); list.addLast(3); list.addFirst(1); return list.values(); }

objective: Maintain head, tail, and next-link invariants while inserting and removing nodes.
workedExample: An empty list has head and tail set to null.
Adding the first node sets both endpoints; adding another node links it after tail and moves tail.
recallPrompt: Which endpoint references must change when the list goes from empty to one node?

misconceptions.explanation: Changing head without first preserving the old chain disconnects the list.
misconceptions.retry: Draw the old head and new node before assigning head.

misconceptions.explanation: After removing the last node, tail must not point at an object outside the list.
misconceptions.retry: Trace removeFirst on a one-node list and state both endpoint values.

reflectionPrompt: Compare the invariant that makes head insertion O(1) with the work needed for addLast.
